descriptions.preferred: The deeply divided, red leaves of this form are usually comprised of seven lobes, long and narrow, and divided almost to the leaf base. Each lobe is elongate-lanceolate with toothed margins. The lobes are 8-9 cm long and held closely together, thus making the leaf appear longer than wide, although the spread is up to 7 cm. The leaves droop slightly and give the plant a ribbonlike effect. The m wide. Occasional pruning shapes it very well. 'Hessei' is a hardy cultivar with sturdy twigs and branches. rhs.description: A deciduous shrub or small tree, to around 1. 2m high, with a spreading habit and deeply cut leaves divided to the base into long narrow lobes. Leaves emerge strongly flushed with red, and deepen to olive green and purple-bronze over summer before turning bright red again in autumn

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained, ideally slightly acidic soil, in a sheltered position with protection from drying winds. Thrives in part shade, as some sun is needed to develop the leaf colour, but will tolerate full sun if soil is reliably moist. Mulch in spring, especially when grown in containers , to improve moisture retention. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Minimal pruning required; see pruning group 1 . Prune from late autumn to mid-winter only

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合用于城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低维护栽培，以及露台/容器栽培。

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性好但排水良好的土壤中，最好为微酸性，并选择避风、可防止干燥风侵袭的位置。最适合半阴环境，因为叶色形成需要一定光照；若土壤能持续保持湿润，也可耐全日照。春季覆 mulch，尤其是盆栽时，可提高土壤保湿性。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 所需修剪极少；参见修剪第 1 组。仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶灌木或小乔木，高约 1. 2 米，株形开展。 叶片深裂至基部，形成细长裂片。 新叶萌发时带有明显红晕，夏季逐渐转为橄榄绿色与紫铜色，秋季再度变为鲜红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该类型的深裂红叶通常由七个裂片组成，裂片细长狭窄，几乎分裂至叶基。 每个裂片呈细长披针形，叶缘具锯齿。 裂片长 8–9 厘米，彼此靠拢，因此叶片视觉上显得长于宽，尽管展开宽度可达 7 厘米。 叶片略下垂，使植株呈现出如带状般的效果。 该品种宽度资料原文残缺。 偶尔修剪即可很好地整形。 'Hessei' 是一个耐寒性良好的品种，枝条与主枝都较为粗壮。 其繁殖并不容易，因为嫁接后愈合较慢。 它还曾以 'Atropurpureum Lacinatum'、'Elegans Atropurpureum'、'Elegans Purpureum' 和 'Lacinatum Purpureum' 等名称流传，但这些名称均为非法名。
